full_prompt_en: A square fantasy character illustration shows a small elderly woman carrying a heavy sack and a broom against a clean white background. The figure stands near the center, facing left in three-quarter view, with her hunched back and large bundle pushing the silhouette toward the right. A tall, crumpled pointed hat rises above wild gray hair. Beneath it, her face is deeply lined, with a long projecting nose, pale blue-gray eyes, and a firm downturned mouth. Dark ragged layers cover her shoulders and torso, while frayed beige fabric hangs in wide uneven tiers around her lower body. One hand stretches forward to hold a short crooked stick that angles toward the left edge. The other rests on the layered cloth at her side, its long fingers emphasized by warm shadow. Behind her, a swollen brown cloth sack is tied across the back, with small knots and gathered seams visible at its upper edge. A bundle of long brown broom bristles extends almost horizontally to the right from behind the skirt. Heavy dark shoes emerge at the bottom. The white ground supplies no setting, only a faint gray contact shadow under the figure and bundle. Light is soft and broadly frontal, catching the face, frayed fabric edges, and rounded sack while leaving deep creases inside the garments. Fine hair strands, dry cloth fibers, worn folds, and muted earthy color give the character tactile weight. The overall composition is isolated and slightly asymmetrical, balancing the pointed hat and forward stick against the large sack and trailing broom.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻角色插画呈现一名身材矮小的年老妇人，背着沉重布袋并带着扫帚，站在干净的白色背景前。人物靠近中央，以四分之三角度朝左，佝偻的背与巨大的包袱把剪影向右推开。一顶高而皱褶的尖帽竖在蓬乱灰发之上。帽下的脸有很深的皱纹、长而前突的鼻子、浅蓝灰眼睛和向下抿紧的嘴。破旧深色衣物层层覆盖肩膀与躯干，磨损的米色布料则以宽大、参差的层叠垂在身体下部。一只手向前伸，握住斜指左缘的短弯木棍。另一只手搭在身侧层叠布料上，长手指由暖色阴影突出。她背后一只鼓胀的棕色布袋绑在身上，上缘可见小结和收拢的缝线。一束长长的棕色扫帚鬃毛从裙后几乎水平地伸向右方。厚重深色鞋子露在底部。白色地面不提供具体场景，仅在人物和包袱下留下淡灰色接触阴影。光线柔和而大体从正面照来，擦亮脸、磨损的布边及圆鼓布袋，衣物深褶内部仍然昏暗。细发丝、干涩布纤维、旧褶皱和低饱和土色赋予人物可触的重量感。整体构图孤立且略不对称，以尖帽和前伸木棍平衡巨袋与拖曳的扫帚。
style_prompt_en: Detailed fantasy illustration models compact forms with fine dry textures and softened painterly shading. A restrained range of soot black, weathered brown, taupe, gray, and dull cream sits against generous white negative space. Frayed edges, tangled threads, narrow creases, and rough granular patches make layered materials feel old and tactile. Contours remain readable without a uniform dark outline; shadow gathers within overlapping folds and beneath projecting masses. Broad soft frontal light reveals the upper planes, while a faint contact shadow gives the isolated form weight. An irregular vertical silhouette is counterbalanced by long low diagonals and an off-center bulge. The overall effect is earthy, whimsical, and slightly eerie, with detail concentrated inside a clear outer shape.
style_prompt_zh: 细节丰富的奇幻插画以细密干涩肌理和柔化的绘画式明暗塑造紧凑形体。烟黑、旧棕、灰褐、灰色和暗乳白组成克制色域，置于宽裕的白色负空间前。磨损边缘、纠结线丝、狭窄褶缝和粗颗粒斑块，使层叠材质显得陈旧可触。轮廓清晰，却没有统一的深色描边；阴影聚在相互遮叠的褶皱里及突出的体块下。宽泛柔和的正面光显露朝上的平面，微弱接触阴影让孤立形体具有重量。参差的竖向剪影由低处的长斜线与偏离中心的鼓起形体平衡。整体效果土色浓厚、带有童话气息又稍显诡异，细节集中在清楚的外轮廓内部。
theme_en: An elderly witch carrying a sack and broom against a white ground
theme_zh: 一名年老妇人背着布袋、带着扫帚，站在白色背景前
